entries.name: hero-4k
entries.prompt: Recreate this EXACT supplied illustration as an ultra high quality 4K 3840x2160 16:9 website hero BACKGROUND. Preserve its exact visual language and composition: cream negative-space sky and river on left half, geometric teal/blue Brazilian city on right half with yellow highlights, huge plain yellow sun behind city, flat rounded emerald/teal tree canopies, elegant charcoal highway curving from lower-right into center distance, white lane dashes, thin guardrail, distant simple bridge. Match the reference's clean 2D editorial vector-like illustrated style precisely. Crisp large geometric shapes with very restrained painterly shading, NO 3D plastic/clay objects, NO photorealism, NO tiny leaves, NO photographic haze. Wide full-bleed scene extends naturally to every canvas edge, NOT an isolated island, no vignette, no rectangular inset, no soft edge masking. Keep upper-left 45% predominantly flat warm ivory #fff9e9 for overlaid HTML copy. Keep main city and sun on right 50%. No text, no letters, no price pins, no phone, no UI, no logos, no watermark. Highest possible native output resolution, target 3840 by 2160.
